# HyperEVM UpOFT <-> RH: DVN Config Fix (1 -> 4 DVNs)

**Chain:** HyperEVM (Chain ID: 999)

**Executor:** Multisig `0x89226a5Fd572f380991Bb17c20c96ba91F98aD2e` (owner **and** LZ delegate on HyperEVM — verified on-chain)

**OApp:** UpOFT `0x642fFC3496AcA19106BAB7A42F1F221a329654fe`

**LZ Endpoint:** `0x3A73033C0b1407574C76BdBAc67f126f6b4a9AA9`


> **Why:** The RH pathway on HyperEVM was configured with only 1 DVN (LZ Labs), while RH's
> receive config requires {LZ, Nethermind, Canary} — so HyperEVM -> RH messages could never
> commit (Nethermind/Canary were never paid on send). This fix sets both directions to the
> same 4-DVN set used by the ETH/Base <-> RH pathways: **LZ Labs, Nethermind, Canary, Superform**.
>
> Until Superform's RH DVN is deployed (RH currently runs 3 DVNs), RH -> HyperEVM delivery is
> gated on that 4th DVN — same posture as RH -> ETH/Base. HyperEVM -> RH works immediately
> after this fix. When the Superform RH DVN ships, only RH's own configs need updating.
>
> ULN: 20 confirmations, 4 required DVNs (sorted ascending), no optional DVNs:
> - Superform:  `0x8024cb9ef7ac7bd51994baf25f52bd43d924a331`
> - Canary:     `0x83342ec538df0460e730a8f543fe63063e2d44c4`
> - Nethermind: `0x8e49ef1dfae17e547ca0e7526ffda81fbaca810a`
> - LZ Labs:    `0xc097ab8CD7b053326DFe9fB3E3a31a0CCe3B526f`
>
> (Addresses per LayerZero metadata API for chain `hyperliquid`.)
